purpose: Teach: ドナー/太陽系/火薬/油田

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、臓器ドナーとレシピエントの相性を医療チームで慎重に確認します
lines.en: Ren, our medical team carefully confirms the compatibility between organ donors and recipients.
lines.style: Calm clinical pace, deliberate and clear, reassuring evenness with weight on 'carefully'.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、太陽系医学、つまり宇宙医療の研究を医療チームでおこないます
lines.en: Ren, our medical team also conducts research in solar system medicine — space medicine, that is.
lines.style: Even teaching tone, a small clarifying pause before restating the term plainly.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、火薬類事故の被害者治療を医療チームで担当します
lines.en: Ren, our medical team handles the treatment of victims of gunpowder accidents.
lines.style: Graver register, slowed pace, respectful weight resting on the victims' treatment.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、油田、つまり油田爆発の救急対応を医療チームでおこないます
lines.en: Ren, our medical team also provides the emergency response for oil field explosions.
lines.style: Composed urgency, crisp articulation, steady confidence describing the emergency response.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、ドナーご家族のグリーフケアを医療チームでおこないます
lines.en: Ren, our medical team provides grief care for donors' families as well.
lines.style: Voice softens noticeably, slower pace, warmth carefully allowed through the clinical calm.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、宇宙、つまり太陽系航行時の医療体制も医療チームで検討します
lines.en: Ren, our team is also studying medical support for space travel — voyages through the solar system.
lines.style: Lighter closing tone, a hint of genuine fascination lifting the final phrase.
